patch_list: Import a locally downloaded extended catalog ZIP instead of waiting for a Play Asset Delivery download that a sideloaded install can never receive. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is requested at launch; without a ZIP the app is unchange…
Adds the "open with" and share-sheet entries that let Stellarium receive a locally downloaded extended catalog ZIP. Used by Stellarium Extended Catalog.
Unlock Stellarium Plus by patching the native license checks, and skip the Play data pack request a sideloaded install cannot satisfy (arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a).

patch_list: Unlock Plus & Gaia Star Catalog - Stellarium Mobile (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks Stellarium Plus subscription features (Gaia DR3 star catalog, full deep-sky objects, high-res planetary textures, satellite tracking) by hooking Google Play Billing and subscription verification.
